description: This Dart source file defines the `MockQuizRepository` class, which provides mock data access methods for quizzes in a testing or development environment. It includes methods to retrieve all quizzes and a specific quiz by ID, leveraging mock data and an inline future utility.

classes.name: MockQuizRepository
classes.description: A mock repository providing quiz data for testing purposes, with methods to retrieve all quizzes or a specific quiz by ID.

methods.name: getAllQuizzes
methods.description: Returns a future resolving to the full list of quiz catalog entries.

methods.name: getQuizById
methods.description: Returns a future resolving to a specific quiz by its ID, or the first quiz if not found.
